title: System Tray Icon disappears after a reboot, even though PowerToys is running.
summary: After reboot, Awake remains active but the PowerToys Runner icon is absent from both the tray and overflow until PowerToys is launched manually.
next_action: Compare the Runner icon at sign-in and after manual launch, using the existing report to check whether the Runner started and registered its icon.

judgment.rationale: The reporter confirmed that tray visibility was already enabled and that the icon is also absent from overflow. Manual launch is an observed control.
judgment.recommended_action: Verify Runner process and tray registration separately rather than repeating the overflow request.

fix_assessment.rationale: A working Awake instance does not prove that Runner started or registered its own icon; the first failing boundary is unknown.

actions.label: Check Runner tray registration after sign-in

reproduce.title: Compare the Runner icon after reboot and manual launch
reproduce.version_requirement: PowerToys 0.102.3101 and latest supported stable as comparison
prerequisites: Disposable Windows account with PowerToys set to start at sign-in and Awake enabled.
setup: Enable PowerToys Runner under Windows Other system tray icons. Use the existing bug report for the affected-machine comparison.
steps: Reboot and sign in. Before opening PowerToys manually, check both tray areas and record whether Runner, Awake, and Explorer are running.
Compare Runner startup and icon-registration events in the existing diagnostics with the fresh sign-in attempt.
Launch PowerToys manually and record whether an existing Runner is reused or a new Runner starts, and whether Quick Access becomes available.
reproduce.expected_result: Runner and its Quick Access icon are available after sign-in without a manual launch. A failure distinguishes missing Runner startup from missing icon registration.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys Runner's tray icon is missing after reboot while Awake appears functional.
known_information: The reporter supplied diagnostics and confirmed the icon is not in overflow even with visibility enabled.
Manually launching PowerToys restores the icon.
inferences: Awake's presence is not a reliable proxy for Runner startup or tray registration.
issue_context.analysis: Compare the sign-in and manual-start paths before deciding whether to investigate startup registration or Explorer notification-area integration.
initial_investigation: Read the report and the reporter's clarification in the issue thread; no local sign-in reproduction was performed.
information_gaps: Runner process state and icon-registration timing before manual launch have not been established.

status.label: Needs Maintainer Verification
status.detail: The overflow control is settled; compare Runner startup and icon registration after sign-in.
